scope: One sender and two destination Macs. In-memory repeated-byte payloads, not model shards or an authenticated MLX ring.
transport: TLS 1.2 or later over direct Tailscale TCP, server and client certificates verified against a fresh test-only CA; a 256-bit SHA-256 acknowledgement verified the received bytes.
limits: Single samples, not sustained throughput or latency SLA; identical repeated bytes were sent. Separate tests from the control Mac encountered SSH transfers timing out, while small commands were intermittent.
cleanup: Task-owned temporary certificate directories were confirmed absent on all three hosts. No model files or service settings were changed.
